# Commonwealth of Nations

> > The official resource for the Commonwealth of Nations, covering member states, governance structures, CHOGM summits, and directories of Commonwealth organizations across sectors including environment, legal affairs, and civil society.

This site serves as the comprehensive reference for the Commonwealth of Nations, an intergovernmental organization of 56 member states. It provides information on Commonwealth governance, including biennial Commonwealth Heads of Government Meetings (CHOGM), organizational directories spanning sectors from environmental sustainability to legal affairs, and key figures in Commonwealth leadership and civil society.

## Key Topics

- Commonwealth of Nations
- CHOGM (Commonwealth Heads of Government Meetings)
- Queen Elizabeth II
- Commonwealth organizations
- Environment and sustainability
- Commonwealth Forestry Association (CFA)
- Commonwealth Human Ecology Council (CHEC)
- Legal affairs and judicial institutes
- Inclusive development
- Commonwealth governance
- Small states
- Human rights
- Economic development
- Millennium Development Goals
- Friendship societies

## Commonwealth Organizations by Sector

- [Environment & Sustainablity](https://www.commonwealthofnations.org/commonwealth-directory/organisations-by-sector/environment-and-sustainablity): Directory of Commonwealth environmental orgs including CFA and CHEC
- [Legal affairs](https://www.commonwealthofnations.org/commonwealth-directory/organisations-by-sector/legal-affairs): Directory of Commonwealth legal organizations and judicial institutes
- [Friendship Societies](https://www.commonwealthofnations.org/commonwealth-directory/organisations-by-sector/friendship-societies): Commonwealth friendship societies including Royal Over-Seas League

## Commonwealth Governance and Summits

- [CHOGM 2013](https://www.commonwealthofnations.org/commonwealth/commonwealth-heads-of-government-meetings/chogm-2013): CHOGM 2013 summit details held in Colombo, Sri Lanka
